rules.label: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: Retail price must be declared, inclusive of all taxes, typically prefixed with 'MRP' and a currency symbol.

rules.label: Net Quantity
rules.description: Net weight/volume/count of the commodity, in standard units (g, kg, ml, l, or count).

rules.label: Month & Year of Manufacture/Packing/Import
rules.description: Month and year the product was manufactured, packed, or imported.

rules.label: Name & Address of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
rules.description: Full name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer of the commodity.

rules.label: Consumer Care Details
rules.description: Contact information (phone, email, or address) for consumer complaints/queries.

rules.label: Country of Origin
rules.description: Required for imported goods — country where the product was manufactured.
